statement.zh: 卡拉尔纪念性建筑、城市聚落与灌溉农业相关碳十四约 2627–1977 cal BCE；中心约 65 ha，距海约 23 km。
statement.en: Caral radiocarbon places monumental architecture, urban settlement, and irrigation agriculture ~2627–1977 cal BCE; ~65 ha central zone, ~23 km inland.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
